airlines.source: FR24 airline page /data/airlines/jtl; Wikipedia J-Air
airlines.note: NOT a Japanese operator. In the schedule data, JTL rows are JL-numbered flights that were mapped via IATA 'JL' to the wrong ICAO code. The real operator is Japan Airlines or J-AIR.
